identity.title: [v0.92.1][V3-04] Implement Application Context And Shared Services

Dependencies remain read-only inputs until terminal evidence satisfies the declared gate.
The issue may not absorb remediation owned by another work package without an explicit issue-graph revision.
operator_constraints: Never write tracked changes on main
Bind only after typed doctor reports ready
Do not cross dependency or stop gates
